Marta — thanks for the packet and the quick summary. A few clarifying points from our side before we sign off for Acme’s SIG:

1) Report age policy: Redwood’s standard for acceptance in SIG/SOC-related reviews is that a full pen test report should be dated within 12 months. For reports slightly older, we accept either: a) a supplemental letter on company letterhead confirming no material changes in scope/controls since the test and an explanation of ongoing monitoring; or b) a scoped retest focused on remediated items (preferred for anything >12 months).

2) Methodology details: can you confirm whether the 2025 engagement included authenticated API testing (token-based endpoints) and whether you performed exploitation verification after remediation? We need specifics to mark the report as sufficient.

3) Firm credentials: please provide the qualifications of the lead testers (CREST/OSCP/OSWE etc.), and whether your firm follows a documented QA sign-off (peer review) for findings. We received RedTeamCo_Credentials.pdf but would like a short one-page attestation summarizing tester certs and QA process.

4) Evidence for remediation: for any findings marked fixed, we require either retest notes or remediation evidence (patch IDs, config diffs, screenshots). If Acme wants a limited retest, can you propose a scoped SOW and ETA?

I’ve looped in Mina to confirm our remediation acceptance criteria/timeline. If you can reply with the requested attestation and a proposed SOW for a limited retest, we can expedite sign-off for Acme.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
